Each obstacle can be bypassed by placing a road or bridge icon on the map, which are available in an unlimited amount. The shorter the route, the more points will be awarded to the player for successful completion.

This means that the player needs to correctly route to the city and bypass all obstacles to get to the amulet.

The game provides several levels that the player can progress through gradually. All levels have unique maps and different obstacles.
